routes.title: Seeti Count Marriage
routes.plain_concept: A pressure cooker whistles, both people are supposed to know which whistle it was, and the marriage becomes a tiny shared investigation.
routes.universal_truth: Some homes are run by two people being confidently unsure together.
routes.aachu_spark: She announces the rule, reacts loudly to every whistle, and turns the cooker into courtroom evidence.
routes.zuv_role: He is not a rescuer; he becomes the equally invested witness, flame-controller, and co-panicker.
routes.proof_beat: Both freeze after a whistle with different finger counts, then quietly negotiate whether it was the second or third.

routes.title: Bedsheet Versus Two Adults
routes.plain_concept: Making the bed becomes a physical wrestling match with one stubborn corner.
routes.universal_truth: Some couples do not make the bed. They negotiate with the mattress.
routes.aachu_spark: She declares one corner wrong and becomes fully invested.
routes.zuv_role: He holds the opposite corner, gets folded into the sheet, and keeps playing instead of correcting.
routes.proof_beat: The fitted sheet snaps back while both blame the corner.

routes.title: Reach Home Live Telecast
routes.plain_concept: A simple 'message when you reach' becomes a full update thread nobody asked for but both secretly like.
routes.universal_truth: Some people do not update you. They narrate the whole journey.
routes.aachu_spark: She sends every micro-update like breaking news.
routes.zuv_role: He reads, reacts, and answers the emotional subtext without making fun of it.
routes.proof_beat: Phone pings show stages of arrival while his face changes from amused to relieved.

routes.title: Gas Cylinder Adulting Ceremony
routes.plain_concept: A gas-cylinder replacement turns two married adults into careful students of adulthood.
routes.universal_truth: Marriage is sometimes two adults Googling adulthood together.
routes.aachu_spark: She gives confident instructions, then steps back at the regulator click.
routes.zuv_role: He tries to be brave, then admits they should call someone who knows.
routes.proof_beat: Both stand at a respectful distance from the cylinder while pretending this is under control.

routes.title: The Lift Came Too Early
routes.plain_concept: The elevator arrives before the couple has finished negotiating whether they are really going out.
routes.universal_truth: Some plans are ready before the people are.
routes.zuv_role: He is still emotionally in bed but physically holding the keys.
routes.proof_beat: Open lift doors, one shoe on, one slipper visible, both frozen.

routes.title: Two People, One Alarm
routes.plain_concept: A morning alarm becomes a shared legal case about who snoozed it.
routes.universal_truth: Some couples do not wake up. They appeal the alarm.
routes.aachu_spark: She denies responsibility with full drama.
routes.zuv_role: He checks the phone, realizes he also snoozed it, and joins the defense.
routes.proof_beat: Alarm screen, tangled blanket, two guilty faces.

routes.title: The Language Lag
routes.plain_concept: She says one thing, means another, and he has learned the lag.
routes.universal_truth: Some relationships have subtitles only one person can read.
routes.aachu_spark: Her phrasing carries hidden emotional weather.
routes.zuv_role: He translates without announcing he translated.

routes.title: He Loves Her Chaos
routes.plain_concept: He smiles calmly at her dramatic energy.
routes.universal_truth: The calm one loves the dramatic one.
